newsitem.title: VATICAN: Vatican condemns Jerusalem market bombing.
newsitem.headline: Vatican condemns Jerusalem market bombing.

text.p: The Vatican deplored Wednesday's fatal bombing in Jerusalem as an attack against innocent people and said peace in the Middle East could only be achieved through dialogue, not violence.
"The Holy See condemns this blind violence which sows death indiscriminately," Vatican spokesman Joaquin Navarro-Valls said in a statement.
The attack by two Arab suicide bombers on a west Jerusalem market killed at least 14 people and injured some 150 people.
"It is not with actions of this kind that peace is reached," Navarro-Valls said, adding that Pope John Paul had stressed that violence only breeds fresh violence.
"Peace, however, is made through continued dialogue and respect for promises already undertaken," the statement said.
